name: Uchida Yoko Co., Ltd.
summary: Uchida Yoko Co., Ltd. provides government and education, office, and information system solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates schools and universities; design, manufacture, supply, and install ICT devices and systems; manufacture and supply educational equipment and systems; design internal layouts and supply furniture and fittings for educational facilities; and provides mission-critical administration services. The company also designs and installs mission-critical systems and associated business software programs; supplies software licensing and IT asset management services; and designs, supplies, installs, and maintains IT equipment and networks.
